questions.subject: Physics
questions.category: Dual Nature of Matter & Radiation :: Multi-Concept Physical Modeling (Type 2)
questions.question: Monochromatic light of wavelength $\lambda$ falls on a metal surface in [Dual Nature of Matter & Radiation], causing emission of photoelectrons with maximum kinetic energy $K_1 = 2\text{ eV}$. When light of wavelength $\frac{\lambda}{2}$ is used on the same surface, the maximum kinetic energy becomes $K_2 = 7\text{ eV}$. What is the work function $\Phi$ of the metal?
questions.solution: Einstein's equations: $K_1 = \frac{hc}{\lambda} - \Phi \implies \frac{hc}{\lambda} = K_1 + \Phi$. For $\lambda/2$: $K_2 = \frac{2hc}{\lambda} - \Phi = 2(K_1 + \Phi) - \Phi = 2K_1 + \Phi \implies \Phi = K_2 - 2K_1 = (7) - 2(2) = 3.0\text{ eV}$.
questions.explanation: Analyze the physical model and equations in Dual Nature of Matter & Radiation.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.category: Dual Nature of Matter & Radiation :: Numerical Derivation
questions.question: One mole of ideal gas undergoes a polytropic expansion $P V^2 = C$ in [Dual Nature of Matter & Radiation] from volume $V_0 = 1\text{ m}^3$ at pressure $P_0 = 10^5\text{ Pa}$ to $V_1 = 2\text{ m}^3$. Calculate the magnitude of work done by the gas in $\text{kJ}$ rounded to nearest integer.
questions.solution: Work done in polytropic process with $n=2$: $W = \frac{P_0 V_0 - P_1 V_1}{n - 1} = P_0 V_0 \left(1 - \frac{V_0}{V_1}\right) = 10^5 \times 1 \times (1 - 0.5) = 5 \times 10^4\text{ J} = 50\text{ kJ}$.
questions.explanation: Calculate using quantitative physical laws in Dual Nature of Matter & Radiation.

questions.solution: Work done in polytropic process with $n=2$: $W = \frac{P_0 V_0 - P_1 V_1}{n - 1} = P_0 V_0 \left(1 - \frac{V_0}{V_1}\right) = 10^5 \times 1 \times (1 - 0.5) = 5 \times 10^4\text{ J} = 50\text{ kJ}$.
questions.explanation: Calculate using quantitative physical laws in Dual Nature of Matter & Radiation.
